ACCOUNTING SERVICES
PROPOSAL
P R O P O S E D  B Y
PACIFIC IMMIGRANT RESOURCES SOCIETY  
21 JUNE, 2025

1. AUDIT PREPARATION & LIAISON 
Objective:
Ensure a smooth and compliant audit process for the previous
fiscal year (ending July 31 2025), including liaisoning with the
auditor.
Scope of Work:
Act as primary liaison with external auditor
Prepare financial statements and documentation for FY audit,
alongside outgoing Finance Director
Conduct a deep-dive review of prior year financials, including
time with the Finance Director to clarify key entries and resolve
outstanding questions
Review and reconcile entries and resolve discrepancies
Coordinate with bookkeeper to compile and validate backup
documentation
Respond to auditor questions within 1–2 business days
Join auditor meetings and coordinate all follow-up items
Prepare PBC (Prepared By Client) list items and ensure timely
delivery
Provide summary audit report and handover notes post-audit
Note: It is ideal to maintain access to the outgoing Finance Director
for 4 weeks for audit preparation purposes. 
Timeline: Approx 8-10 weeks - based on audit timeline

2. BOOKKEEPING OVERSIGHT &
FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
Objective:
Ensure accurate, timely, and funder-compliant bookkeeping through
hands-on oversight, quality control, and support for PIRS’s internal
bookkeeper, while gradually introducing process improvements and
clearer financial reporting systems.
Scope of Work:
Manage all AP/AR and monthly reconciliations to ensure accuracy
Oversee day-to-day tasks of junior bookkeeper with regular
check-ins and support especially for accounts payable
Evaluate bookkeeper’s performance over a 2–3 month period and
recommend future staffing model
Manage accounts receivable, including invoicing, grant
management and donations
Develop and implement GL coding standards aligned with
internal, funder, audit requirements
Conduct monthly financial reviews and trial balance checks for
accuracy
Assist with cash flow tracking and monthly budget variance
analysis tied to project-based reporting needs
Prepare monthly financial summary reports for EDs and
leadership
Develop a bookkeeping calendar and approval workflow 
Timeline: Ongoing

3. PAYROLL MANAGEMENT 
Objective:
To manage end-to-end payroll processing and accounting w/ system
integration and compliance, while evaluating platform options. 
Scope of Work:
Manage payroll cycles (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, or
monthly) for full-time, part-time, seasonal, and contract staff
Process hourly staff and contractor payments, including
government-funded programs like Canada Summer Jobs
Handle employee changes, new hires, terminations, and vacation
tracking within payroll software
Reconcile payroll data with QuickBooks each cycle; implement
workarounds to reduce manual spreadsheet use
Ensure accurate source deductions (CPP, EI, income tax) and
submit federal/provincial remittances
Track payroll liabilities such as vacation pay, statutory
deductions, and year-end accruals
Prepare and file T4, T4A, and ROE forms in line with CRA and
provincial requirements
Maintain and update employee records in payroll system
Develop a payroll calendar and approval workflow with manager
cutoffs and review steps
Evaluate whether to continue with PayWorks or transition to
QBO Payroll for better integration and efficiency
Note: While we manage all payroll accounting and processing,
managers must provide timely payroll data (e.g., timesheets, new
hires, exits). We do not manage HR functions.
Timeline: Ongoing

4. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION &
STAFF TRAINING
Objective:
Conduct a full digital systems audit to identify integration gaps,
inefficiencies, and implement inclusive, user-friendly processes that
improve funder reporting and reduce manual work.
Scope of Work:
1. Audit & Strategy Development
Conduct a deep-dive review of current financial systems,
processes, and overall tech stack
Hold meetings with the outgoing Finance Director and current
team to understand existing workflows, strengths, and
challenges
Assess the current chart of accounts, class structure, and GL
setup to identify gaps and areas for improvement
Evaluate existing budget templates at both the organizational
and departmental levels
Review project and funder reporting templates and compare
them to internal financial reporting tools
Map current workflows and process flows; identify inefficiencies,
redundancies, and compliance risks
Assess digital literacy levels across staff and review system
integration points between teams
Recommend updated workflows, approval processes, and
internal controls to improve efficiency and compliance
Propose refinements to the tech stack to reduce manual work
and improve automation and reporting
Develop and deliver future-state process maps and a clear
transformation roadmap

4. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION &
STAFF TRAINING
2. Implementation of Improved Tools and Processes
Configure the chart of accounts and GL structure to align with
funder and internal management reporting needs
Develop project-level accounting structures for tracking actuals
and generating program-specific reports
Create standardized reporting templates aligned with key funder
compliance and reporting requirements
Integrate payroll, expense management, and payment systems
with the central accounting platform
Establish internal workflows for expense submission, approval,
and GL coding
Implement budget tracking tools and reporting mechanisms to
support monthly and quarterly reviews
Set up integrated cash flow projection tools to accounting data
Test all system integrations and validate the accuracy 
Coordinate with internal leads and external vendors to ensure
smooth setup and configuration
3. Staff Training and Change Management
Deliver role-specific training sessions tailored to tools and
processes
Develop SOPs, quick guides, and workflow documentation
Offer 2 months of ongoing post-training support for adoption
and troubleshooting
Conduct post-training survey to gather employee feedback on
new processes
Timeline: Approx 12-18 weeks (based on final scope)

WHY US?
Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial
clarity and timely support. We bring:
A responsive, detail-oriented team
Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
BIPOC and immigrant-led leadership with lived experiences in
community, social service and arts & culture
We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and
building long-term trusted partnerships
Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and
integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a
commitment to helping our partners thrive.

ACCOUNTING SERVICES PROPOSAL
PROPOSED BY
PACIFIC IMMIGRANT RESOURCES SOCIETY
21 JUNE, 2025

1. AUDIT PREPARATION & LIAISON
Objective:
Ensure a smooth and compliant audit process for the previous fiscal year (ending July 31 2025), including liaising with the auditor.
Scope of Work:
- Act as primary liaison with external auditor
- Prepare financial statements and documentation for FY audit, alongside outgoing Finance Director
- Conduct a deep-dive review of prior year financials, including time with the Finance Director to clarify key entries and resolve outstanding questions
- Review and reconcile entries and resolve discrepancies
- Coordinate with bookkeeper to compile and validate backup documentation
- Respond to auditor questions within 1–2 business days
- Join auditor meetings and coordinate all follow-up items
- Prepare PBC (Prepared By Client) list items and ensure timely delivery
- Provide summary audit report and handover notes post-audit
Note: It is ideal to maintain access to the outgoing Finance Director for 4 weeks for audit preparation purposes.
Timeline: Approx 8-10 weeks - based on audit timeline

2. BOOKKEEPING OVERSIGHT & FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
Objective:
Ensure accurate, timely, and funder-compliant bookkeeping through hands-on oversight, quality control, and support for PIRS’s internal bookkeeper, while gradually introducing process improvements and clearer financial reporting systems.
Scope of Work:
- Manage all AP/AR and monthly reconciliations to ensure accuracy
- Oversee day-to-day tasks of junior bookkeeper with regular check-ins and support especially for accounts payable
- Evaluate bookkeeper’s performance over a 2–3 month period and recommend future staffing model
- Manage accounts receivable, including invoicing, grant management and donations
- Develop and implement GL coding standards aligned with internal, funder, audit requirements
- Conduct monthly financial reviews and trial balance checks for accuracy
- Assist with cash flow tracking and monthly budget variance analysis tied to project-based reporting needs
- Prepare monthly financial summary reports for EDs and leadership
- Develop a bookkeeping calendar and approval workflow
Timeline: Ongoing

3. PAYROLL MANAGEMENT
Objective:
To manage end-to-end payroll processing and accounting with system integration and compliance, while evaluating platform options.
Scope of Work:
- Manage payroll cycles (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, or monthly) for full-time, part-time, seasonal, and contract staff
- Process hourly staff and contractor payments, including government-funded programs like Canada Summer Jobs
- Handle employee changes, new hires, terminations, and vacation tracking within payroll software
- Reconcile payroll data with QuickBooks each cycle; implement workarounds to reduce manual spreadsheet use
- Ensure accurate source deductions (CPP, EI, income tax) and submit federal/provincial remittances
- Track payroll liabilities such as vacation pay, statutory deductions, and year-end accruals
- Prepare and file T4, T4A, and ROE forms in line with CRA and provincial requirements
- Maintain and update employee records in payroll system
- Develop a payroll calendar and approval workflow with manager cutoffs and review steps
- Evaluate whether to continue with PayWorks or transition to QBO Payroll for better integration and efficiency
Note: While we manage all payroll accounting and processing, managers must provide timely payroll data (e.g., timesheets, new hires, exits). We do not manage HR functions.
Timeline: Ongoing

4. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION & STAFF TRAINING
Objective:
Conduct a full digital systems audit to identify integration gaps, inefficiencies, and implement inclusive, user-friendly processes that improve funder reporting and reduce manual work.
Scope of Work:
1. Audit & Strategy Development
- Conduct a deep-dive review of current financial systems, processes, and overall tech stack
- Hold meetings with the outgoing Finance Director and current team to understand existing workflows, strengths, and challenges
- Assess the current chart of accounts, class structure, and GL setup to identify gaps and areas for improvement
- Evaluate existing budget templates at both the organizational and departmental levels
- Review project and funder reporting templates and compare them to internal financial reporting tools
- Map current workflows and process flows; identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and compliance risks
- Assess digital literacy levels across staff and review system integration points between teams
- Recommend updated workflows, approval processes, and internal controls to improve efficiency and compliance
- Propose refinements to the tech stack to reduce manual work and improve automation and reporting
- Develop and deliver future-state process maps and a clear transformation roadmap

4. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION & STAFF TRAINING (Continued)
2. Implementation of Improved Tools and Processes
- Configure the chart of accounts and GL structure to align with funder and internal management reporting needs
- Develop project-level accounting structures for tracking actuals and generating program-specific reports
- Create standardized reporting templates aligned with key funder compliance and reporting requirements
- Integrate payroll, expense management, and payment systems with the central accounting platform
- Establish internal workflows for expense submission, approval, and GL coding
- Implement budget tracking tools and reporting mechanisms to support monthly and quarterly reviews
- Set up integrated cash flow projection tools to accounting data
- Test all system integrations and validate the accuracy
- Coordinate with internal leads and external vendors to ensure smooth setup and configuration

3. Staff Training and Change Management
- Deliver role-specific training sessions tailored to tools and processes
- Develop SOPs, quick guides, and workflow documentation
- Offer 2 months of ongoing post-training support for adoption and troubleshooting
- Conduct post-training survey to gather employee feedback on new processes
Timeline: Approx 12-18 weeks (based on final scope)

WHY US?
Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial clarity and timely support. We bring:
- A responsive, detail-oriented team
- Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
- Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
- BIPOC and immigrant-led leadership with lived experiences in community, social service and arts & culture

We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and building long-term trusted partnerships

Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a commitment to helping our partners thrive.

• Budget & Cash Flow Tools: Implement budget tracking tools and reporting mechanisms to support monthly and quarterly reviews; set up integrated cash flow projection tools linked to accounting data.
• Testing & Validation: Test all system integrations and validate accuracy.
• Coordination: Coordinate with internal leads and external vendors to ensure smooth setup and configuration.
